title: ‘It is definitely NOT ‘smarter’ than a human’: Why AI hype may be creating risks of its own as people trust it too much at scale
description: This article explores the misconceptions surrounding artificial intelligence (AI), the dangers of overestimating AI's capabilities, and the important distinctions between human intelligence and AI functionalities.
content:
AI is no longer just a tool for finding information. But the bigger debate is not whether it is “smart” or “dangerous” , it is whether people understand what it can and cannot do before trusting it.

title: OpenAI to terminate Cursor model access following SpaceX acquisition
description: Artificial intelligence research company OpenAI, on Friday, decided to end its commercial partnership with coding platform Cursor following the platform's acquisition by Elon Musk's aerospace and technology firm SpaceX.
